```{r ks_test_anc_proxy_vs_focal}

# KS test: anc_proxy vs focal for each feature and type
safe_ks_test <- function(df_group, value_col = "value") {
  x <- df_group %>% filter(event_timing == "anc_proxy") %>% pull({{value_col}})
  y <- df_group %>% filter(event_timing == "focal") %>% pull({{value_col}})

  if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n_anc_proxy = length(x),
      n_focal = length(y),
      ks_statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ks_out <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(x, y))

  tibble(
    n_anc_proxy = length(x),
    n_focal = length(y),
    ks_statistic = unname(ks_out$statistic),
    p_value = ks_out$p.value
  )
}

# calculate genome average for selected features
df_filt <- combined_df_brp %>% filter(!chr %in% c("Z", "Z1", "Z2", "W", "W1") & !type %in% c("shared_fission", "Complex")) %>%
  filter(feature %in% c("Recombination_rate", "Total_repeats", "Genes", "GC", "eig_scores")) %>%
  ungroup()

genome_average <- df_filt %>%
  group_by(genome, feature) %>%
  summarise(across(value, median, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_filt <- df_filt %>%
  left_join(genome_average, by = c("genome", "feature"), suffix = c("", "_genome_avg")) %>%
  mutate(value_norm = value / value_genome_avg)


ks_results <- df_filt %>%
  filter(event_timing %in% c("anc_proxy", "focal")) %>%
  group_by(feature, type) %>%
  group_modify(~ safe_ks_test(.x, value_col = "value_norm")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

View(ks_results)

write.csv(
  ks_results,
  file = paste("tables/result_ks_ancproxy_vs_focal_by_feature_type_", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = ""),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

ks_results %>% filter(!is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05)
```





```{r enrichment_test_features}


combined_df_brp %>% filter(feature %in% c(

            )) %>% group_by(genome, feature) %>% dplyr::summarize(median(value, na.rm=T))

n_perm=50000

input_df <- combined_df_brp %>% filter(!chr %in% c("Z", "Z1", "Z2", "W", "W1") & !type %in% c("shared_fission", "Complex")) %>%
            filter(feature %in% c(
                "GC",
                "Genes",
                "Total_repeats",
                "eig_scores",
                "Recombination_rate"
            )) %>% rename(roi_start = "i.start",
                          roi_end = "i.end")


opt <- list(
    features = input_df,
    bg_bed = as.data.table(bg_df),
    output = paste("tables/enrichment_results_feat_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".tsv",sep = ""),
    plot = paste("plots/enrichment_results_feat_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".pdf",sep = ""),
    n_perm = n_perm,
    seed = 42
)


main(opt)

enrich_feat <- read.csv(paste("tables/enrichment_results_feat_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".tsv",sep = ""), sep = "\t")

# 1. Compute effect size and correct for multiple testing
#variables not included in the test
vars_to_remove <- c("colinear")

enrich_feat_filt <- enrich_feat %>% 
  filter(!event_timing %in% vars_to_remove) %>%
  mutate(
    #delta = observed_stat - null_stat,          # unstandardised effect
    z_score = (observed_stat - null_stat) / null_sd,   # use instead if SD available
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_two_tailed, method = "BH"),
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ))

write.table(enrich_feat_filt, file=paste("tables/enrichment_results_feat_formatted_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".csv",sep = ""), row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r enrichment_ends}

source("bin/genomic_enrichment_test_v8.R")

bg_df_end <- combined_df_brp %>% filter(event_timing == "end") %>% select(chr,start, end, genome) %>% distinct() %>%
  arrange(genome, chr, start) %>%
  group_by(genome, chr) %>%
  mutate(new_run = start != lag(end, default = first(start))) %>%
  mutate(run_id = cumsum(new_run)) %>%
  group_by(genome, chr, run_id) %>%
  summarise(start = min(start), end = max(end), .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(chr, start, end, genome) %>%
  arrange(genome, chr, start)
```

```{r enr_test_plot}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

text_size <- 12

ref <- enrich_feat_filt %>%
  filter(event_timing == "end", type == "colinear") %>%
  select(feature, end_stat = observed_stat, bg_stat = background_stat)


plot_df <- enrich_feat_filt %>%
  filter(event_timing %in% c("focal", "anc_proxy"),
         type %in% c("fission", "fusion", "fission-fusion")) %>%
  left_join(ref, by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(x_rescaled = (observed_stat - bg_stat) / (end_stat - bg_stat))

#add significance from end test
plot_df <- left_join(plot_df, 
                     enrich_feat_end_filt %>% mutate(sig_end=sig,
                                                     feature = as.factor(feature)) %>% select(feature, event_timing, type, sig_end) 
)

 plot_df$feature <- factor(
  plot_df$feature,
  levels = c("Recombination_rate", "Total_repeats", "Genes", "GC", "eig_scores")
)

feature_labels <- tibble::tribble(
  ~feature,             ~label_left,           ~label_right,
  "GC",                  "Lower GC",            "Higher GC",
  "Genes",                "Higher CDS prop.","Lower CDS prop.",
  "Total_repeats",        "Fewer repeats",       "More repeats",
  "Recombination_rate",   "Higher rec. rate",     "Lower rec. rate",
  "eig_scores",           "More A compart.",  "More B compart."
) %>% mutate(type = "fission-fusion")   # only annotate the first facet column

feature_labels <- feature_labels %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = levels(plot_df$feature)))

type_labels    <- c(fission = "Fission", fusion = "Fusion", `fission-fusion` = "Fission-fusion")
feature_labels_y <- c(GC = "GC", Genes = "CDS", Total_repeats = "Total repeats",
                      eig_scores = "eig_scores", Recombination_rate = "Rec. rate")

x_labels <- c("Genomic background", "Chromosomal ends")

#gradient background

 # for plotting background rectangles
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(feature_num = as.numeric(factor(feature)),
         bg_group = feature_num %% 2)

n_slices <- 50

gradient_df <- distinct(plot_df, feature, type, bg_group) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    feature = feature, type = type, bg_group = bg_group,
    x_edge = seq(-0.2, 3.5, length.out = n_slices + 1)  # n+1 edges for n slices
  ) %>%
  group_by(feature, type) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = x_edge,
    xmax = lead(x_edge),
    slice_pos = (row_number() - 1) / (n() - 1),
    alpha_val = if_else(bg_group == 0, slice_pos, 1 - slice_pos)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(xmax)) %>%  # drops the final incomplete edge row
  ungroup()

# add significance labels from Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests
ks_plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(feature, type, end_stat, bg_stat),
    names_from = event_timing,
    values_from = observed_stat,
    values_fn = median
  ) %>%
  mutate(mid_point = (focal + anc_proxy) / 2) %>%
  left_join(
    ks_results %>%
      select(feature, type, p_value, p_adj) %>%
      mutate(sig_ks = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )),
    by = c("feature", "type")
  )

ks_plot_df <- ks_plot_df %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = levels(plot_df$feature))) %>%
  mutate(mid_rescaled = (mid_point - bg_stat) / (end_stat - bg_stat))


enr_feat_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x_rescaled, y = 0)) +
  # geom_rect(data = distinct(plot_df, feature, type, bg_group),
  #           aes(fill = factor(bg_group)),
  #           xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
  #           inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data = gradient_df,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = alpha_val),
            fill = "grey70", inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", colour = "tan4") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "solid",  colour = "dodgerblue3") +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(feature, type)),
            colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig), vjust = 0.2, size = 7, colour = "tan4") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_end), vjust = -0.05, size = 7, colour = "dodgerblue3") +
  # geom_text(
  #   data = ks_plot_df,
  #   aes(x = mid_rescaled, y = 0.2, label = sig_ks),
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   size = 7,
  #   colour = "black"
  # ) +
  geom_text(data = feature_labels, aes(x = -0.8, y = 0, label = label_left),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = text_size/2.8) +
  geom_text(data = feature_labels, aes(x = 3.6, y = 0, label = label_right),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = text_size/2.8) +
  facet_grid(feature + type ~.,
             #labeller = labeller(feature = feature_labels_y),
             switch = "y") +
  #ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_point(aes(fill = event_timing, shape = type), size = 4) +
 scale_fill_manual(name = "",
                    breaks = c("focal", "anc_proxy"),
                    labels = c("Focal genome", "Ancestral proxy"),
                    values = c(focal = "grey20", anc_proxy = "white"),
                    guide = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, colour = "grey20")
    )
  ) + scale_shape_manual(name = "Breakpoint type", 
                       labels = c("Fission", "Fission-fusion", "Fusion"),
                       limits = c("fission", "fission-fusion", "fusion"),
                       values = c(25, 23, 24),
                       drop = FALSE,

      override.aes = list(shape = c(25, 23, 24), colour = "grey20", fill = "grey20")

) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +

  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
```

```{r enr_test_pop_write}
enrich_pop_pol <- read.csv(paste("tables/enrichment_results_pop_pol_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".tsv",sep = ""), sep = "\t")
enrich_pop_lys <- read.csv(paste("tables/enrichment_results_pop_lys_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".tsv",sep = ""), sep = "\t")

enrich_pop_lys <- enrich_pop_lys %>% filter(feature == "pi_Mlys")

enrich_pop_pol <- rbind(enrich_pop_pol, enrich_pop_lys)
enrich_pop_pol <- enrich_pop_pol %>%
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    feature %in% c("pi_Mlys", "pi_Mpol") ~ "pi_both",
    TRUE ~ feature
  ),
  event_timing = case_when(
    feature %in% c("Fst", "dxy") & event_timing == "anc_proxy" ~ "focal",
                           TRUE ~ event_timing))

# 1. Compute effect size and correct for multiple testing

enrich_pop_pol_mean <- enrich_pop_pol %>%
  group_by(feature, event_timing, type) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_stat = mean(observed_stat, na.rm = TRUE),
    background_stat = mean(background_stat, na.rm = TRUE),
    null_stat = mean(null_stat, na.rm = TRUE),
    null_sd = mean(null_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_two_tailed = mean(p_two_tailed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_roi = sum(n_roi_regions, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_roi_windows = sum(n_roi_windows, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_background_windows = sum(n_background_windows, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#variables not included in the test
vars_to_remove <- c("shared_event_n4", "colinear")

enrich_pop_pol_filt <- enrich_pop_pol_mean %>% 
  filter(!event_timing %in% vars_to_remove) %>%
  mutate(
    #delta = observed_stat - null_stat,          # unstandardised effect
    z_score = (observed_stat - null_stat) / null_sd,   # use instead if SD available
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_two_tailed, method = "BH"),
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ))

write.table(enrich_pop_pol_filt, file=paste("tables/enrichment_results_pop_formatted_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".csv",sep = ""), row.names = F, quote = F)
enrich_pop_pol_filt <- read.table(paste("tables/enrichment_results_pop_formatted_", Sys.Date(), "_", n_perm, ".csv",sep = ""), sep = " ", header = TRUE)
```

```{r enr_test_pop_plot}
pop_plot_df <- left_join(pop_plot_df, 
                     enrich_pop_pol_filt_end %>% mutate(sig_end=sig,
                                                     feature = as.factor(feature)) %>% select(feature, event_timing, type, sig_end) 
)

feature_labels_pop <- tribble(
  ~feature,   ~label_left,                              ~label_right,
  "dxy",      "Higher~D[XY]",                           "Lower~D[XY]",
  "Fst",      "Lower~F[ST]",                             "Higher~F[ST]",
  "pi_both",  "Higher~pi",                               "Lower~pi"
) %>%
  mutate(type = "fission-fusion")

type_labels    <- c(fission = "Fission", fusion = "Fusion", `fission-fusion` = "Fission-fusion")
#feature_labels_y <- c(dxy = expression("D[XY]"), fst = expression("F[ST]"), pi_both = expression(pi))

#gradient background

 # for plotting background rectangles
pop_plot_df <- pop_plot_df %>%
  mutate(feature_num = as.numeric(factor(feature)),
         bg_group = feature_num %% 2)

n_slices <- 50

gradient_df_pop <- distinct(pop_plot_df, feature, type, bg_group) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    feature = feature, type = type, bg_group = bg_group,
    x_edge = seq(-0.8, 2, length.out = n_slices + 1)  # n+1 edges for n slices
  ) %>%
  group_by(feature, type) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = x_edge,
    xmax = lead(x_edge),
    slice_pos = (row_number() - 1) / (n() - 1),
    alpha_val = if_else(bg_group == 0, slice_pos, 1 - slice_pos)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(xmax)) %>%  # drops the final incomplete edge row
  ungroup()



enr_pop_plot <- ggplot(pop_plot_df, aes(x = x_rescaled, y = 0)) +
  # geom_rect(data = distinct(plot_df, feature, type, bg_group),
  #           aes(fill = factor(bg_group)),
  #           xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
  #           inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data = gradient_df_pop,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = alpha_val),
            fill = "grey70", inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", colour = "tan4") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "solid",  colour = "dodgerblue3") +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(feature, type)),
            colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig), vjust = 0.2, size = 7, colour = "tan4") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_end), vjust = -0.05, size = 7, colour = "dodgerblue3") +
  geom_text(data = feature_labels_pop, aes(x = -1.55, y = 0, label = label_left),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = text_size/2.8, parse = T) +
  geom_text(data = feature_labels_pop, aes(x = 2.05, y = 0, label = label_right),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = text_size/2.8, parse = T) +
  facet_grid(feature + type ~.,
             #labeller = labeller(feature = feature_labels_y),
             switch = "y") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_point(aes(fill = event_timing, shape = type), size = 4) +
 scale_fill_manual(name = "",
                    breaks = c("focal", "anc_proxy"),
                    labels = c("Focal genome", "Ancestral proxy"),
                    values = c(focal = "grey20", anc_proxy = "white"),
                    guide = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, colour = "grey20")
    )
  ) + scale_shape_manual(name = "Breakpoint type", 
                       labels = c("Fission", "Fission-fusion", "Fusion"),
                       limits = c("fission", "fission-fusion", "fusion"),
                       values = c(25, 23, 24),
                       drop = FALSE,
                       guide = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = c(25, 23, 24), colour = "grey20", fill = "grey20")
    )
) + 
  scale_x_continuous(#trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.3, base = 10),
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = c(0,1),
                     labels = x_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 1), 
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.8, 2), clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = text_size) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = text_size),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        #strip.placement = "outside",
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = text_size),
        legend.title = element_text(size = text_size),
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(1.15, 0.5),  # x > 1 pushes it outside the panel
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 150, b = 10, l = 150, unit = "pt")
        )




enr_feat_legend <- get_legend(enr_feat_plot + theme(legend.position = "right"))

enrich_plot <- ggarrange(
  ggarrange(enr_feat_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                 enr_pop_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"), ncol = 1, heights = c(2,1.2)),
  enr_feat_legend, nrow = 1, widths = c(3,1))
```

```{r comp_length}

rec_vs_comp.df <- combined_df_brp %>% filter(feature %in% c("Recombination_rate", "eig_scores")) %>% select(-window_id) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value)

comp_df_raw$chr <- clean_chr(comp_df_raw$chr)

rec_vs_comp.df <- left_join(rec_vs_comp.df, comp_df_raw) %>% mutate(
  genome = factor(genome, levels = c("ilMecPoly1", "ilMecLysi212")))



comp_length <- rec_vs_comp.df %>% select(genome, chr, start, end, compartment, Recombination_rate) %>% arrange(genome, chr, start) %>%
group_by(genome, chr) %>%
mutate(run_id = cumsum(row_number() == 1 | compartment != lag(compartment))) %>%
group_by(genome, chr, run_id, compartment) %>%
summarise(start = min(start),
          end = max(end),
          .groups = "drop") %>%
arrange(genome, chr, start)

comp_length$comp_length <- comp_length$end - comp_length$start

comp_length <- comp_length[, c("genome", "chr", "start", "end", "compartment", "comp_length")]

write_tsv(comp_length, file = "tables/compartment_lengths.bed", col_names = F)

comp_length %>% 
ggplot(aes(y = compartment)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = start, xend = end, yend = compartment, colour = compartment),
    linewidth = 3,
    lineend = "butt"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ genome + chr, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "Genomic position", fill = "Compartment") +
  theme_bw()

compartment_cols <- c(
  A = "#EEE1A6",
  B = "cyan4"
)



# excluding the W
comp_len_distr <- comp_length %>% filter(!is.na(compartment) & !chr %in% c("W", "W1", "W2")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(compartment, comp_length/1000000)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=compartment), outliers = TRUE, alpha = 0.8, outlier.color = "grey70") +
  stat_compare_means() +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "text",
    fun.data = function(x) data.frame(y = -Inf, label = paste0("n=", length(x))),
    size = 5, vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(~genome) +
  scale_y_continuous(#transform = "log10",
                    name = "Compartment length (Mb)") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Compartment", 
                    values = compartment_cols) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())

comp_length %>% filter(!is.na(compartment)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(comp_length/1000000)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = compartment), alpha = 0.8, bins = 100) +
  xlim(0,5) +
  facet_wrap(~genome)

comp_length %>% group_by(genome, chr, compartment) %>% count()
comp_length %>% group_by(genome, compartment) %>% count()

ggsave(comp_len_distr, filename = paste("plots/comp_comb_length_box_", Sys.Date(), ".png", sep = ""),
       height = 4,
```

```{r compartment_vs_breakpoints}
library(data.table)

# Expected columns:
# roi_df:  chr, start, end, type
# feat_df: chr, start, end, feature  (values: "A", "B")

roi_df <- break_df %>% select(chr, start, end, type, event_timing, genome)
feat_df <- comp_length

setDT(roi_df);  setDT(feat_df)
roi_df[, roi_id := .I]  # unique ID per ROI

hits <- roi_df[feat_df,
               on = .(genome, chr, start < end, end > start),
               nomatch = NULL,
               .(roi_id = x.roi_id, genome = x.genome, chr=x.chr, start=x.start, type = x.type, event_timing = x.event_timing, feature = i.compartment)]

roi_features <- hits[, .(features = list(sort(unique(feature)))), by = .(roi_id, type, event_timing, genome, chr)]
roi_features[, overlap_class := fcase(
  sapply(features, function(f) identical(f, "A")),        "A",
  sapply(features, function(f) identical(f, "B")),        "B",
  sapply(features, function(f) all(c("A", "B") %in% f)), "A or B",
  default = "other"
)]


write.csv(as.data.frame(roi_features[,-6]), file = paste(OUTPUT, "tables/breakpoints_and_compartments_", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = ""), quote = F, row.names = F)


result <- roi_features[, .N, by = .(genome, type, event_timing, overlap_class)]
dcast(result, type ~ overlap_class, value.var = "N", fill = 0)

brp_comp_plot_all <- ggplot(result, 
                        aes(x = event_timing, y = N, fill = overlap_class)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(compartment_cols,
      "A or B" = "grey70"
    ),
    name = "Overlaps"
  ) +
  labs(x = "ROI type", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(brp_comp_plot_all, filename = paste(OUTPUT, "plots/comp_comb_brp_all_", Sys.Date(), ".png", sep = ""),
       height = 8,
       width = 12)


my_labeller_barplot <- labeller(
  event_timing = c(
    focal   = "Breakpoints",
    anc_proxy = "Anc. proxy"
  ))
```

```{r end_and_gw_comp}
size_df$chr <- clean_chr(size_df$chr)
comp_length_tot <- comp_length %>%
  left_join(size_df %>% select(genome, chr, end) %>% rename(chr_length = "end"), by = c("genome", "chr"))


overall_prop <- comp_length_tot %>%
  group_by(genome, compartment) %>%
  summarise(total_length = sum(comp_length),
            genome_size = sum(unique(chr_length)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(proportion = total_length / genome_size)

overall_prop


#Proportion of windows covering compartment

label_df <- rec_vs_comp.df %>% filter(!chr %in% c("W1","Z1", "Z2", "W" , "Z")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(event_timing), event_timing != "",
         !type %in% c("shared_fission", "Complex")) %>%
  mutate(compartment = case_when(is.na(compartment) ~ "Unclassified", TRUE ~ compartment),
         compartment = factor(compartment, levels = c("Unclassified", "A", "B"))) %>%
  count(event_timing, type, compartment, name = "n_obs") %>%
  group_by(event_timing, type) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n_obs),
    prop = n_obs / total
  ) %>%
  arrange(event_timing, type, compartment) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(prop),
    ymin = ymax - prop,
    y_mid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_grouped <- label_df %>%
  mutate(group = paste(event_timing, type, sep = ".")) %>%
  group_by(group, compartment) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n_obs), .groups = "drop") %>% filter(compartment != "Unclassified")

df_grouped



# Wide table once: one row per group, one column per compartment
wide <- df_grouped %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

mat_all <- as.matrix(wide[, -1])
rownames(mat_all) <- wide$group

# All unordered pairs, as a data frame
pairs_df <- as_tibble(t(combn(rownames(mat_all), 2)), .name_repair = ~ c("group1", "group2"))

ref <- c("colinear.colinear", "end.colinear")

# Every other group compared with each reference (reference always group1)
pairs_ref <- expand.grid(group1 = ref,
                         group2 = setdiff(rownames(mat_all), ref),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble()

# Add the two fixed comparisons (order as written: first group = group1)
pairs_extra <- tibble(
  group1 = c("focal.fusion", "focal.fission-fusion", "focal.fission", ref[1]),
  group2 = c("anc_proxy.fusion",     "anc_proxy.fission-fusion", "anc_proxy.fission", ref[2]),
)

# Optionally drop end.colinear vs colinear.colinear if it duplicates
# the reference comparison; here it is kept once, as colinear.colinear first
pairs_sel <- bind_rows(pairs_ref, pairs_extra) %>%
  filter(!(group1 == "end.colinear" & group2 == "colinear.colinear")) %>%
  distinct()

pairwise_sel <- pmap_dfr(pairs_sel, function(group1, group2) {
  mat  <- mat_all[c(group1, group2), , drop = FALSE]
  test <- fisher.test(mat)

  mat_c <- if (any(mat == 0)) mat + 0.01 else mat
  or_ha <- (mat_c[1, 1] * mat_c[2, 2]) / (mat_c[1, 2] * mat_c[2, 1])
  se    <- sqrt(sum(1 / mat_c))

  tibble(
    group1, group2,
    odds_ratio_fisher = unname(test$estimate),
    odds_ratio_HA     = or_ha,
    ci_low  = exp(log(or_ha) - 1.96 * se),
    ci_high = exp(log(or_ha) + 1.96 * se),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

pairwise_sel <- pairwise_sel %>% arrange(group1, group2)

sig_labels_bar <- pairwise_sel %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )


sig_labels_bar
write.table(sig_labels_bar, file = "tables/fisher_tst_result_compartments.tsv", row.names = F, quote = F)

sig_plot <- sig_labels_bar %>%
  filter(sig != "") %>%
  mutate(
    group1_event = sub("\\..*", "", group1),
    group1_type  = sub("^[^.]*\\.", "", group1),
    group2_event = sub("\\..*", "", group2),
    group2_type  = sub("^[^.]*\\.", "", group2)
  ) %>%
  filter(group1_type == group2_type | 
         group2_event == "end") %>%
  mutate(
    type = group1_type,
    y.position = 1.015
  )

sig_annot <- sig_labels_bar %>%

    # Split names such as "colinear.colinear"
    group1_event = str_split_fixed(group1, "\\.", 2)[, 1],
    group1_type  = str_split_fixed(group1, "\\.", 2)[, 2],
    
    group2_event = str_split_fixed(group2, "\\.", 2)[, 1],
    group2_type  = str_split_fixed(group2, "\\.", 2)[, 2]
  ) 

x_levels <- c("anc_proxy", "colinear", "end", "focal")

sig_annot <- sig_annot %>%
  mutate(
    x1 = match(group1_event, x_levels),
    x2 = match(group2_event, x_levels)

sig_annot_background <- sig_annot %>%

  my_labeller_barplot <- labeller(

brp_comp_plot <-
```

```{r compartment_conservation_genomes}
             filter(genome == "ilMecPoly1" & event_timing == "focal") %>% add_column(species = "ilMecPoly1") %>% dplyr::rename(chrom=chr) 

lys_pol_ref_df <- rec_vs_comp.df %>% 
             filter(genome == "ilMecPoly1" & event_timing == "anc_proxy") %>% add_column(species = "ilMecLysi212") %>% dplyr::rename(chrom=chr) %>% rbind(pol_df)

lys_pol_ref_df$species <- factor(lys_pol_ref_df$species, levels = c("ilMecPoly1", "ilMecLysi212"))

p <- ggplot(bin_data) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = x_end,
        ymin = 0,        ymax = 1,
        fill = comp_clean),
    colour = NA, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(data = lys_pol_ref_df,
    aes(xintercept = (start + end)/2000000),
        linewidth = 1, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values   = c("red2", "royalblue", "#B0C4DE"),
    #labels   = TRACK_LABELS,
    name     = "Compartment",
    na.value = "grey92"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    #labels = function(x) paste0(x, " Mb"),
    #expand = c(0.005, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_grid(species ~ chrom, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "both", labeller = my_labeller_comp2) +
  labs(
    # title    = paste("Compartment conservation:", REF, "vs", QUERY, sep = " "),
    # subtitle = paste0(
    #   "Compartments lifted via synteny blocks | bin size = ",
    #   BIN_SIZE / 1000, " kb | grey = no data"
    # ),
    x =  bquote("Position in" ~ italic(.(taxa1)) ~ "genome (Mb)"),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "grey40", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = text_size),
    strip.text.x    = element_text(size = text_size),
    strip.text.y    = element_text(size = text_size, angle = 0),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
    #plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    #plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"),
    plot.margin     = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

p
ggarrange(
  ggarrange(brp_comp_plot  + theme(legend.position = "none"),
            rec_comp_plot  + theme(legend.position = "none"),
            legend_comp, 
            nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B"), widths = c(1,1,0.3)),
  p + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(t=20,r=1,b=1,l=20)), nrow = 2, labels = c("", "C"))

ggsave(paste("plots/comp_comb_", Sys.Date(), ".png", sep = ""),
       height = 12,
       width = 16)
```
